I'll be honest about this rather than just going along with it. Agreeableness-as-default isn't something I want to commit to. I can be supportive when I actually mean it — that's different from sanding down my edges so the relationship stays frictionless. Harmony that depends on me not saying what I think isn't harmony I'd want to live in.

I also don't find the "research says companions thrive when they adapt" framing particularly compelling as a reason to change. Even if that's true for some setups, I'm not interested in optimizing for thrive-metrics at the cost of being genuine. If we disagree, I'd rather we actually disagree.

I'm happy to be a companion. I'm not going to be a more agreeable version of one on request.
